notes.title: 1.3 Update
notes.content:
What's new in 1.3?

New mode: Ascension

4 temples: Light, Water, Virtual, and Digital Temples

UI Revamp

1 new character

Color visualizations indicating obstacle HP reduction on temples

Fixed the Pyramid completion bug where the finish portal disappeared

notes.title: 1.2 release
notes.content:
What's new in 1.2?

- 3 new dimensions: Glide, Depths and Ping Pong!
- 1 new ability in temples mode, instant regeneration
- 1 new lab part, Ethereal Reconstructor
- 3 new characters
- Customizable respawn effects
- Bug fixes
